metadata.title: The Stock Market’s Midterm Winners and Losers

content.text:
LIVE
Updated 8 min ago
The Stock Market’s Midterm Winners and Losers
Winners
🍃☀️Wind and solar power: Turbine makers Vestas and Nordex, offshore-wind company Orsted and solar-power names including First Solar, Hanwha Q-Cells, OCI Holdings and SMA Solar all jumped on hopes the Democratic wave will counter the Trump administration’s anti-green-energy policies.
⚕️Healthcare: Stocks such as Centene, HCA Healthcare and Universal Health climbed. A Democratic Congress will have more leverage to strike a deal with President Trump to boost spending on Obamacare.
